scope.method: Static review only; no edits to repository, build, or emulator.

findings.title: Valid CharSequence share payloads are discarded
findings.condition: ACTION_SEND with type text/plain and EXTRA_TEXT containing a non-String CharSequence, such as SpannableString.
findings.evidence: EXTRA_TEXT supports CharSequence. getStringExtra only retrieves String; for a styled CharSequence it returns null, so model.receive is never called. The next line removes the payload, making it unavailable for a later retry.
findings.impact: Sharing a valid URL as styled text opens the app without accepting the URL.
findings.recommendation: Read getCharSequenceExtra(Intent.EXTRA_TEXT)?.toString() before forwarding and consuming the payload.

test_gaps.gap: Share test covers only a String payload delivered directly to onNewIntent. Add non-String CharSequence, initial cold launch, and share followed by recreation cases.

Rotation covers only the home URL. No language switch/recreation coverage on pre-33 and 33+, locale selection after restart, layout-direction assertion, or Android system app-language reset coverage exists in the reviewed tests.
ActivityScenario.recreate keeps the ViewModel. These assertions do not establish process-death restoration of draft input, shared content, or navigation.
